title: Service Staff Charged on a Delivered Event
content:
Service staff on a Private Event & Banquet Services event are counted up to the next whole member at the guests per server printed against the package and charged at the staff rate per hour printed against the same package for the service hours included in it.

## Which count the staff are counted on

1. Where a delivered entry stands for the booking and the guests served passed the count the guarantee confirmed, the staff are counted on the guests served.
2. Where a delivered entry stands for the booking and the guests served did not pass the count the guarantee confirmed, the staff are counted on the guaranteed count, the roster having been booked to it.
3. Where no delivered entry stands for the booking, no service staff stand on the bill.

Guests served equal to the count the guarantee confirmed did not pass it, and so fall in the second case. Counting up to the next whole member means any part of a member is charged as a whole member.

## The three figures each package prints

| Package | Guests per service staff member | Service staff rate, USD per hour | Service hours included |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 34 | 0.0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 25 | 36 | 2.0 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 20 | 38 | 4.0 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 16 | 42 | 5.0 |
| Gala Reception Package | 12 | 48 | 6.0 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 18 | 40 | 10.0 |

## Worked illustration on hypothetical records

An event on the Conference Day Delegate Package was guaranteed to 140 guests and served 152. The guests served passed the guaranteed count, so the staff are counted on 152: at 20 guests to each member that is 8 members, and 8 members at 38 for each hour over the 4.0 service hours included come to 1216 on the bill. Had 131 guests been served, the staff would be counted on 140, that is 7 members, coming to 1064.
